title: DocMap archive (archivio / cluster)
description: One of the separate archives of a studio, as written by DocMap v12 (normalizeArchive in assets/js/02e-archives.js): S.archives, workspace JSON, sync packages, server records of type 'archive'. Binders and locations point to it with archive_id ('' = the default archive 'Archivio principale', id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000a0001, which exists as a record only once it has been edited). Contract: docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §15.

id.description: Stable id (UUID v4), never changed. The default archive has the fixed id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000a0001.

name.description: Display name (Archivio storico, Comune di …). '' only for the default archive = shown as 'Archivio principale' / 'Main archive'.

code.description: Short code (ST, COM): uppercase letters and digits, max 8, unique among archives. Accepted by the CSV column archive_id.

color.description: Colour of the archive (dot in the switcher, cards, chips).

sort.description: Order in lists (the default archive comes first).

levels.description: Level names and code prefixes of this archive's location tree, from the largest to the smallest. [] = the office levels settings.locLevels (always the case for the default archive, which keeps using the v11 setting).

qr_levels.description: 0-based levels that get a QR label (cabinet front, shelving unit, box). [] = only the deepest level.

updated_at.description: Drives last-write-wins like binders and locations.
